fee_notes: Bakery franchise fee is $40,000 (standard); reduced fees for Bakeries have ranged from $15,000 to $25,000 depending on location, format, and other circumstances. Concession Truck or Trailer fee is $7,500. Additional Concession Truck or Trailer within an existing Mobile Area costs $5,000 each. Discounts of 25% off the initial franchise fee are available for Veterans/Active-Duty Military, First Responders, and Existing Franchisees (discounts cannot be combined). No discounts offered for subsequent Concession Trucks or Trailers.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee for a WETZEL'S PRETZELS Bakery is $40,000. ... Typically, for Bakeries where we approve a reduced initial franchise fee, the initial franchise fee has ranged from $15,000 to $25,000, depending on location, format, and other circumstances. ... If you will operate your franchise from a Concession Truck or Trailer, then the initial franchise fee is $7,500 to be paid in cash or other form of payment that will make the funds immediately available to us (such as wire transfer or cashier's check).
